concept.title: About alerts
concept.shortdesc: An alert is a notice that raises when a device needs attention.

conbody.p: This topic applies to . Operators use alerts to see which devices need attention and to record that someone has reviewed them.

image.alt: Flow diagram. A reading with vibration above the limit, or any other alert, creates an open alert. When an operator selects Acknowledge, the alert becomes acknowledged.

dlentry.dd: An operator has reviewed the alert. records who acknowledged it and when.

section.title: Automatic critical alerts
section.p: When a device reports vibration above , the platform raises a critical alert automatically.
